decision: not adopted: models/restore_daytime_net.pt (v2, KITTI only) stays the final restorer
observations: on real glare the v3 restorer does not improve car AP (0.110 vs C1 0.112) or per-frame F1 (0.089 vs 0.091); the small mAP gain on glare frames comes from rare classes with few boxes
on KITTI v2 synthetic val it recovers 44% of the loss vs 67% for the v2 restorer (expected: different glare)
v3 synthesis matches real-glare brightness and locality much better (results/synth_v3_fit.json) but still fails the shortcut test (results/shortcut_test_v3.json)
